episodes.instruction: Take hold of the brown bottle and the green plastic bottle with ridged bottom at once.
Use one arm for the bottle with red screw cap and the other for the green plastic bottle with ridged bottom.
Lift the bottle with red screw cap and the green bottle with white label at the same time.
Use one arm for the brown bottle and the other for the green bottle.
Raise the brown bottle and the green bottle together.
Pick both the brown bottle and the green bottle with white label up in parallel.
Use one arm for the plastic soda bottle and the other for the green bottle.
Pick both the plastic soda bottle and the green plastic bottle with ridged bottom up in parallel.
Use separate arms to pick the bottle with red screw cap and the green plastic bottle with ridged bottom simultaneously.
Lift the brown bottle and the green bottle at the same time.
Hold the plastic soda bottle in one arm and the green bottle in the other.
Raise the brown bottle and the green bottle with white label together.
Use separate arms to pick the plastic soda bottle and the green bottle with white label simultaneously.
Use one arm for the brown bottle and the other for the green bottle.
Pick both the bottle with red screw cap and the green bottle up in parallel.
Use separate arms to pick the brown bottle and the green plastic bottle with ridged bottom simultaneously.
